ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0091_D: Del: We're running out of time!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0095_D: Del: You need to take them out!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0096_D: Del: Alright! Now to disarm the other two terminals before they explode.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0097_L: Luke: I don't see any more terminals.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0098_D: Del: Agh! The terminals must be hidden in amber!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0099_D: Del: We’ve got four minutes before the system explodes!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0100_D: Del: We’ve got three minutes before the system explodes!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0101_D: Del: We’ve got two minutes before the system explodes!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0102_D: Del: We don't have much time before the system explodes!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0103_D: Del: We only have a few minutes before the system explodes!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0111_D: Del: I’ll take care of it. Just hold off those bugs.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0112_L: Luke: I’d say we’re both lucky.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0113_D: Del: I thought there was more to it than that.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0114_D: Del: That's it! Only one terminal left.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0118_D: Del: Of course I can. It's why they sent me.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0122_D: Del: This is it. The Emperor's Obervatory.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0124_D: Del: We’re getting close to the Emperor’s Observatory.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0125_L: Luke: So that's why you're here.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0126_D: Del: Don't worry. I'm here to destroy it.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0128_D: Del: Fix this and I'll disarm the defenses.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0130_D: Del: Hey. You said you'd fix this.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0134_D: Del: The defense system activated. The clock is officially ticking.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0135_L: Luke: What kind of defense system is this?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0138_L: Luke: These bugs are very unhappy.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0140_L: Luke: I'll hold them off. Keep working.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0142_D: Del: These tremors mean we’re running out of time.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0143_D: Del: I think we're waking up the bugs!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0144_D: Del: I don’t think the cavern can take much more of this.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0146_D: Del: More tremors! They're still coming!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0147_D: Del: Hard to believe, but I’m kind of glad you’re here. Couldn’t have done this alone.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0150_D: Del: I can’t work with all these bugs!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0151_D: Del: Smash those pillars and find them, fast!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0152_D: Del: Hit the amber, just like before!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0154_D: Del: You can cut the amber pillars!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M3PIL_DS02_S1000_GP_0156_D: Del: It's inside one of the pillars!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0002_H: Hask: They’ll evacuate when ordered to. Their fearlessness in the face of this storm shows true discipline.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0006_D: Del: And now, she’s calling in a favor.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0009_H: Hask: This is all for the greater good, Commander.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0013_D: Del: But Gleb deserves an early evacuation, does she?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0034_H: Hask: This is just the beginning. When people see what we’ve done here, that terror will spread throughout the galaxy.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0035_H: Hask: Civilians are...expendable. Our people will evacuate first.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0041_I: Iden: Gleb oversees the Future Imperial Leaders school here. She crafts loyal, capable troopers.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0042_D: Del: This storm is unnatural. I’ve never seen anything like it. The locals must be terrified.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0059_I: Iden: The people of Vardos are loyal to the Empire. Why should they be left to suffer?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0060_I: Iden: None of this looks good to me. Vardos was our home, Hask.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0061_H: Hask: The Empire is our home. Operation: Cinder is a test to prove that we are worthy of what it will become.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0062_I: Iden: You sound like my father.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0067_I: Iden: We’ll find Protectorate Gleb in the Archive. Follow me.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0068_H: Hask: Do you still remember your way, Commander?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0069_I: Iden: I don’t forget so easily, Agent.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0070_D: Del: I'm just surprised we aren't evacuating civilians.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0090_H: Hask: Maybe that’s because I listen to the Admiral's orders.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0091_D: Del: Are we really here for one person? Civilians could die here.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0092_I: Iden: We've put our troopers in harm's way, as well.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0094_D: Del: This is an Imperial world. A place we're supposed to protect.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_GP_0095_I: Iden: Don't forget the chain of command, Agent.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0004_I: Iden: We’re too exposed. We need to get out of the open.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0006_I: Iden: Nothing about that felt good. But it was necessary. They would have killed us, Del.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0007_D: Del: It's okay, Commander. Come on.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0017_I: Iden: Hold your fire. If they spot us, we're in trouble.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0019_I: Iden: We got lucky. C’mon, into the passageway.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0020_I: Iden: There's a passageway on the other side of the plaza. That's our way out.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0022_D: Del: Let's keep it that way.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0023_D: Del: The storm is picking up.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0024_I: Iden: We need to get off this planet.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0009_D: Del: Letting them pass unharmed...that was gracious.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0010_I: Iden: We don't need to kill everyone we see. Come on.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0013_I: Iden: Be careful! This way is faster, but we're in the open!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0014_I: Iden: We'll be safer down here, but might run into more of them...
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0017_I: Iden: Wait. Wait... let it pass.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0018_I: Iden: Droid, override protocol. Scan Imperial signatures as hostile.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0021_I: Iden: That should at least help us get to the AA defenses. Now, follow me and stay quiet.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0026_I: Iden: Keep it together, Agent Meeko. We have civilians on the **Corvus** relying on us.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0030_I: Iden: We have to reach the **Corvus** and get out of Imperial space. It’s our only chance.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0031_D: Del: You heard your father. They'll shoot it down before we can leave.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0032_I: Iden: Then we need to take down the anti-air cannons.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0036_D: Del: We don't have Imperial comms anymore. The **Corvus** won't even know we're coming.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0038_D: Del: I hated having to do that.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0039_I: Iden: We've been sentenced to death. We protect ourselves, or we die.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0041_I: Iden: We can shut down the anti-air systems ahead.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0044_I: Iden: This way. Stay quiet and they won't see us coming.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0005_D: Del: The cannons are strong enough to punch through the anti-air turbolasers.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0008_D: Del: Lots of troopers up here.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0009_I: Iden: Walkers deploy troopers in this area.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0014_I: Iden: Exactly. And if we destroy the targeting dishes, we'll disable every AA in the sector.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0015_I: Iden: Maintain cover. We're going to steal an AT-AT.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0017_D: Del: Where are they all coming from?!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0018_I: Iden: Walkers deploy troopers in this area!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S0700_GP_0022_I: Iden: Take them down, we're going to steal an AT-AT!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1100_NIS_0001_: Iden: Del, take the controls. I have the weapons.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0002_C: Caton: Commander! I've got the civilians you sent to the ship.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0004_C: Caton: Yes, Commander. I'm with you, no matter what they say. Careful in that storm.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0017_D: Del: Keep blasting it. We've got nowhere else to go!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0021_C: Caton: Hurry, Commander! The storm is--
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0022_D: Del: Oh no. Iden, above us!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0042_D: Del: I'm bringing us as close as I can.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0045_D: Del: Just punch through that wall and we can get to the **Corvus**.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0046_D: Del: Commander, I need you to blast that wall.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0047_D: Del: We have a barricade blocking our path.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0048_D: Del: You did it! Weapons in this sector are disabled.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0053_I: Iden: Escaping ships. We're not the only ones searching for safety.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0061_I: Iden: Good. Lock down the **Corvus**. Agent Hask will send troopers to capture the Raider.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0062_I: Iden: Get to the **Corvus**. We're leaving Vardos.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0063_D: Del: Hey, we have Imperial comms again.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0074_D: Del: I can't believe how far the Admiral is willing to go.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0076_D: Del: His orders aren't good enough.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0077_I: Iden: Neither were ours. We need to get those civilians off Vardos.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0078_D: Del: I see the anti-air cannons.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0081_I: Iden: First we get out of Imperial space, then we come up with a plan.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0088_D: Del: We need to take down that AA cannon.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0092_D: Del: Let's take out that dish.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0093_D: Del: I see a targeting dish.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0098_D: Del: We've got stormtroopers in the area.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0114_I: Iden: There! The main targeting dish! If we destroy it, it will disable every turret in the sector!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0115_D: Del: Take it down, I'll get us to the **Corvus**.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0116_D: Del: Commander, lay into that targeting dish!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0117_D: Del: We need to take out that dish, Commander.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0118_D: Del: You're clear to fire on the dish.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1200_GP_0126_D: Del: We're almost out of this.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1300_NIS_0003_: Iden: We're almost out of this.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0006_D: Del: We're out of time. We need to get on the **Corvus**!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0008_C: Caton: Yes, Commander, but that lightning is shorting out our systems. It might take some time.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0009_C: Caton: Ramp is down, you're clear to board Commander.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0011_I: Iden: Everyone to the **Corvus**, I'm right behind you!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0017_D: Del: You heard the Commander, move!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0024_I: Iden: They'll do everything they can to keep us grounded!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0025_D: Del: Just get me in the **Corvus**, I'll fly us out of here!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0026_I: Iden: Blast! That's a lot of stormtroopers.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0027_D: Del: Our crew is under attack!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0028_I: Iden: **Corvus**, lower the ramp, get everyone on board.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0037_I: Iden: Stay out of the open!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M4VAR_DS02_S1500_GP_0048_I: Iden: Hold off that scout walker!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0050_L: Lando: To settle a bet. Shriv thinks you’re Imperial spies.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0052_L: Lando: I think you're scared. Running for your lives.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0053_L: Lando: Listen. You gave us good intel on Operation: Cinder. In return, I’ve got two starfighters, just for you.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0054_D: Del: Wait. You're letting us leave?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0055_L: Lando: That’s right. Start a new life. Find somewhere safe.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0056_I: Iden: Somewhere you can track us.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0057_S: Shriv: We’re too busy for that.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0058_L: Lando: We just got word that Operation: Cinder is headed to Naboo.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0059_D: Del: You have to stop it.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0060_L: Lando: I think we can handle it.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0061_I: Iden: You’re wrong. The Empire is changing, and so are its tactics.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0062_L: Lando: If that’s the case, why not come with us? Help save Naboo.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0063_I: Iden: We’re not here to join your Rebellion.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0064_S: Shriv: No one's asking you to.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0065_L: Lando: This is a one-time deal. You can leave right now, or you can help stop this.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0066_I: Iden: You really trust us to fight beside you?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0067_L: Lando: What can I say? I'm a big believer in second chances.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0200_GP_0068_L: Lando: Come on. I'll show you to your ships.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0023_L: Leia: The Empire is scrambling our sensors.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0034_L: Leia: We'll handle the last of them. You take care of that Star Destroyer.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0035_R: Danger 3: On your position, Danger Leader!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0036_R: Danger 4: Yeah, we're with you, Shriv!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0037_S: Shriv: All right. Let's remind the Empire who they're messing with.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0041_S: Shriv: We'll just have to use our eyes.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0042_R: Danger 3: You've got the biggest ones, Danger Leader.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0043_S: Shriv: Yeah, I do! So, follow me, and shoot those satellites.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0051_R: Danger 3: I've gotta admit, these new pilots are all right. Think you'll stick around?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0052_I: Iden: We're here to stop Cinder, and then we're gone.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0054_S: Shriv: Once we clear out those satellites, our capital ship can broadside that Destroyer. You know what to do.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0059_L: Leia: I'm seeing a heat signature under the central satellites.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0060_D: Del: That should be the thermal power core.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0061_L: Leia: Then that's where we focus our firepower.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0062_S: Shriv: We have a lot more to go! Get moving!
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0065_S: Shriv: Good for her. Get into formation, fly to the next satellite.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0067_S: Shriv: Hey, hey. She's not a Commander in my unit.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0071_S: Shriv: Naboo is one step closer to safety.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0074_S: Shriv: And then you're gone for good, right?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0080_I: Iden: Do we have any satellites left?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0081_S: Shriv: Oh, I'm sure you are. Just know, if either of you tries something, I'll shoot you down myself.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0082_I: Iden: You really think you could?
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0083_S: Shriv: They don't call me Danger Leader for nothing.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0085_R: Danger 3: Steer clear of that Destroyer. Its cannons cut right through our shields.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0086_R: Danger 4: Squad leader, I'm in pursuit, regrouping on you once this guy is dust.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0088_L: Leia: Our squadron just took out a satellite.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0089_L: Leia: We just got another satellite.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0090_L: Leia: Another dish down in my sector.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0091_I: Iden: I've got a bad angle.
ID_SW02_VO_A1_M5NAB_DS02_S0400_GP_0094_R: Danger 4: That's not making a dent.

ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0064_S: Shriv: Nice shot. General Solo, I'm tracking another inbound on your position.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0066_I: Iden: I see a TIE near the castle, Del, take him out.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0071_P: Paldora: Inferno Squad defected as well, you know. Statistically they have a 91 percent mission success rate in the Republic, according to my data.{0s:7s} That's 3 points higher than their Imperial statistics!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0072_P: Paldora: You know, between the Empire's self-imposed destruction of Scarif and the rapid slowing of progress at Fondor, I'm surprised the Empire's willing to risk command ships of that size.{0s:7s} The Kuat Drive Yards can only replace so many ships!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0074_H: Han: I don't care if Maz is on the comm, I don't want to talk to her right now.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0078_H: Han: One less fighter to worry about.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0080_I: Iden: Save some for us, General.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0084_M: Maz: That had better be the last of them, Solo.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M1TAK_DS02_S0700_GP_0085_H: Han: I told you I'd take care of it.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0004_D: Del: There's always more to it than luck.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0009_I: Iden: I think it’s cute you study a planet’s wildlife before we visit.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0018_I: Iden: According to Paldora's intel, my father's been refueling his fleet at Chinook Station for months. Our old friend Hask is overseeing the operation. If we can capture him and shut down the station, we’ll strike a solid blow to the Empire.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0021_D: Del: Iden! They'll spot you out there.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0022_D: Del: Careful, the Star Destroyers might see you!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0024_D: Del: Not to mention, Hask could be the key to finally tracking down the Admiral.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0030_I: Iden: He will be. Paldora said he's leading this emergency fueling operation.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0031_D: Del: You know, if we find your father, take him out of the fight, we’ll be a lot closer to ending this war.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0032_I: Iden: I know it’s been a rough six months, but we’ll get him this time. I can feel it.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0033_D: Del: I don’t doubt that. I was actually curious about what happens afterward, when the war is over.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0034_I: Iden: Honestly, I haven’t really thought about it. A life of Imperial training isn’t worth much in the civilian sector. What about you?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0035_D: Del: Thought I might travel. See the galaxy. Lothal, Mykapo...
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0036_I: Iden: You’ve been to those places.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0037_D: Del: As a soldier. I want to see them when they’re free.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0038_I: Iden: That actually sounds really nice.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0039_D: Del: Take a look at all these Beldons.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0040_D: Del: If they make the Tibanna Gas the Empire needs, the Beldons are mission critical.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0042_D: Del: You think Hask will actually be here?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0200_GP_0043_I: Iden: There's the landing pad. They shouldn't spot our ships down here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0020_T: Imperial: Be on the lookout. Commander Hask says Rebel activity has been reported in the region.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0021_T: Imperial: The uprising can't be that stupid.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0022_T: Imperial: You’re probably right, but the Commander is not in a forgiving mood.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0024_T: Imperial: Did the inspection go sideways?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0025_T: Imperial: Chinook Station’s output is down two percent from his last visit.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0027_T: Imperial: There’s no one down here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0028_T: Imperial: Blast. I’ll patrol down here until Commander Hask leaves.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0029_I: Iden: Hask will be in the Overseer’s Tower, on the main level. We’ll need to find a turbolift to get there.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0041_I: Iden: The Droid says there’s one ahead, along with a stormtrooper squad. Follow my lead.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0043_T: Imperial: How can you tell? I can’t see a thing.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0044_T: Imperial: Well, nobody’s shooting at us.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0046_T: Imperial: I doubt the Rebels even know we’re here. There hasn’t been single attack since we commandeered this station.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0047_T: Imperial: Or they’re just biding their time.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0048_T: Imperial: I’m telling you, nobody can get through the Iron Blockade.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0049_T: Imperial: Even if you’re right, I don’t want to fight them in this fog.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0051_T: Imperial: Make another pass. I don’t want anything slipping through the cracks while Commander Hask is here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0054_I: Iden: All clear. Let's get to that lift.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0300_GP_0055_D: Del: Security is tighter than we thought. Getting to Hask won’t be easy.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0510_NIS_0001_: Iden: Well, don’t just stand there, soldier. Let's get a move-on.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0007_S: Imperial: Hey! What's all that chatter?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0008_I: Iden: Just marveling at the might of the Empire, sir. Rebels don’t stand a chance.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0014_T: Imperial: Last night on the station. I'll almost miss this old rig.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0016_T: Imperial: Yeah, waiting on my shuttle.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0030_T: Imperial: I hear the blockade is starting to crumble. Ships are breaking through all across the Anoat sector.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0031_T: Imperial: This is Governor Adelhard’s fault. He should have put down the uprising as soon as it began.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0033_I: Iden: Droid, we're at the tower. You ready?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0072_I: Iden: Ha! Look at this! A cloud car! Can you even imagine sitting in that cockpit?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0073_D: Del: I don’t know. Doesn’t seem too bad.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0074_I: Iden: No real pilot would ever fly one of these.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0080_D: Del: Ever since Endor, the Empire's occupations have only gotten worse. This could have been us, Iden. You and I.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0082_I: Iden: Well, this brings back memories.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0083_D: Del: Not any of the good ones.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0084_I: Iden: The Overseer’s Tower is straight ahead. Hask should be on the top floor.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0086_T: Imperial: Where are they sending you?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0087_T: Imperial: I heard something about the Western Reaches, but who knows. That’s above my pay grade. What about you?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0088_T: Imperial: Cloud City. Command thinks the uprising is planning an attack.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0091_D: Del: I'm amazed how busy the station is.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0092_I: Iden: The Empire’s on the run. Their resources are dwindling. They need this fuel to keep the fleet running, now more than ever.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0096_T: Imperial: I was told to put them here, sir.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0099_T: Imperial: How long until it reaches us?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0100_T: Imperial: Doesn’t matter. Word is, something big is coming down from up high. Something that will finally turn the tide.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0101_I: Iden: Get ready, Del. Knowing Hask, he’ll put up a fight.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0102_D: Del: I'm looking forward to it.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0104_H: Hask: Did you really think it would be so easy?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0106_H: Hask: We picked up the **Corvus** the second it slipped through the blockade. If it were up to me, I’d deal with you personally, but... I have responsibilities now. Taking care of you is no longer one of them. Goodbye, Iden.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0107_I: Iden: No, no, no! We can't let him get away!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0108_I: Iden: Think about all the good we've done since Vardos, Del. We've made the galaxy safer. Given people hope.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0109_D: Del: It's time we did the same for Bespin. Let's find Hask.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0110_T: Imperial: Commander's up there now, wrapping things up.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0111_T: Imperial: Fueling has commenced, our last Destroyer just arrived.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0112_T: Imperial: Any updates from the sublevel squad?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0113_T: Imperial: Weapons unloaded, get me a droid for inventory.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0600_GP_0114_T: Imperial: Contact the lieutenant overseeing silos. Make sure they can supply those ships.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0007_C: Imperial: We lost comms with the squad in the tower, so stay alert. Everyone spread out! Commander Hask wants them found!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0008_D: Del: That Star Destroyer. That must be Hask.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0009_I: Iden: So much for that plan.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0026_D: Del: The whole station knows we’re here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0027_I: Iden: We’re going to have to fight our way off Chinook Station.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0030_I: Iden: Hask was just one part of the mission.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0031_D: Del: You still want to take out the fueling op. How do you plan to do that?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0033_D: Del: The X-wings are on the other side of the station. Droid, is there anything closer we can use?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0036_I: Iden: They’re still looking for us. Stay close and wait until I open fire.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0042_I: Iden: That’s all of them. Now let’s find that ship.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0700_GP_0048_I: Iden: Run, Del! Get off the platform!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0800_GP_0001_I: Iden: When I said we needed a ship, I should have been more specific.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0800_GP_0002_D: Del: It has weapons! What more do you want?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0800_GP_0003_I: Iden: For it to not be a cloud car!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0002_D: Del: You were right. The cloud car was not a good choice for this.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0012_D: Del: Too bad Hask slipped through our fingers.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0016_P: Pilot: Command, I've got eyes on a cloud car inbound on your Destroyer.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0017_D: Del: This thing is patched into Imperial comms!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0018_I: Iden: At least it's good for something.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0019_C: Imperial: Sigma One-Two, adjust approach vector for intercept. Probably out for a delivery, but we can't be too careful.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0022_P: Pilot: That cloud car isn't making a delivery!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0024_P: Pilot: All units, form up on my position, rogue cloud car at point-oh-three-two. Shoot it down!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0025_C: Imperial: One-two, stop that ship! We're losing fuel cells! Our fleet needs this Tibanna Gas!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0026_P: Pilot: Trying, Command, it's a slippery one.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0027_C: Imperial: Pilot one-two! We cannot fire our cannons until fueling completes, or we'll ignite the entire refinery! STOP THEM!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0028_P: Pilot: But...if we miss, and hit the fuel cells, we'll all die!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0032_I: Iden: No, think about it. All we need do is take out the fuel cells--
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0033_D: Del: And the explosion will cause a chain reaction.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0034_I: Iden: Exactly. All the way back to those Star Destroyers.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0035_D: Del: That is the craziest thing I have ever heard.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M2BES_DS02_S0900_GP_0040_I: Iden: Which we're going to blow up.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0200_GP_0001_S: Shriv: Turbolasers. This place is pretty well defended for a deserted weapons cache.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0200_GP_0002_L: Lando: I only brought you for the company, but look at that! Tactical analysis!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0200_GP_0003_S: Shriv: Give me a break. I know my way around Sullust. After all, I did help liberate the place.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0200_GP_0004_L: Lando: That would explain why the Empire is still here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0200_GP_0007_S: Shriv: Uh... shouldn’t you be following mine? This is still an Inferno Squad mission.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0200_GP_0008_L: Lando: And I'm still a General.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0200_GP_0010_S: Shriv: Okay. That was a good one.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0300_GP_0001_O: Imperial: The demands of the Empire have outgrown your supply. Admiral Versio has ordered you to double your production immediately.{0s:6s} These weapons are vital to our plans in the Western Reaches. Those not on the assembly line will patrol the area.{6s:13s} It is imperative our presence remain undetected. Now, get back to work!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0300_GP_0014_S: Shriv: If you're gonna shoot 'em, let's just get this over with.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0300_GP_0017_S: Shriv: Uh, Lando. Are we going inside?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0300_GP_0019_S: Shriv: Can we go inside now? It's really hot out here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0300_GP_0030_S: Shriv: Throw a smoke, they can't see through it.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0300_GP_0031_S: Shriv: Hit 'em with a smoke grenade, would ya?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0001_S: Shriv: Ugh, great, I'm sweating. Are you sweating?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0002_S: Shriv: Check out this old assembly line. The Empire used it to assemble AT-ATs.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0003_S: Shriv: It's busted. We can't get in.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0005_L: Lando: Here. Climb into this cockpit.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0006_S: Shriv: That’s gonna be...comfortable. Here we go.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0008_S: Shriv: Are you seeing this? This facility isn't abandoned! They're in full production!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0009_L: Lando: Okay. So, we’ll steal the weapons and shut down the factory. Easy enough.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0010_S: Shriv: That's what you said about rescuing Han Solo from Jabba's Palace.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0011_L: Lando: We’ll figure it out. We always do.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0012_S: Shriv: I absolutely do not miss this.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0013_S: Shriv: There! That's the central terminal. We can shut down the factory’s power from there. Just need to get past all these stormtroopers...
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0018_S: Shriv: Okay. Let's get to that central terminal and shut off the power.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0019_L: Lando: When I open fire, you know what to do.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0020_R: Protocol Droid: Lava systems are at 100 percent and pump systems are functional. Please monitor their stability to avoid catastrophic overflow.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0023_T: Imperial: I'm sweating like a happabore in this armor.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0027_S: Shriv: Hey, we're not dead. Nice. Let's get to that terminal and shut this place down.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0028_S: Shriv: Nothing ever goes according to plan when you're around.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0029_L: Lando: Come on. You and me, back in action! Tell me you don't miss this!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0030_S: Shriv: Hey, uh. Can you move? Your cape is in my way.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0032_S: Shriv: You have no sense of personal space.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0033_L: Lando: But I have a great sense of style.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0400_GP_0043_L: Lando: If we start the assembly line, it should carry us inside.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0410_SE_0002_S: Shriv: You know what you're doing, right?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0410_SE_0004_R: Protocol Droid: Unauthorized input detected. Security lockdown initiated.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0410_SE_0006_L: Lando: Looked like a power button to me.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0410_SE_0007_L: Lando: Okay, new plan. This place runs on lava, right?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0410_SE_0008_S: Shriv: Yes. Why? What are you gonna do?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0410_SE_0009_L: Lando: Improvise. You just find us a ride out of here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0410_SE_0010_S: Shriv: Whatever gets me farthest from you.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0500_GP_0003_L: Lando: Hmm. Those lava pumps could be just what I need.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0500_GP_0005_L: Lando: Just like Shriv to miss out on all the fun.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0500_GP_0008_S: Shriv: Well, whatever it is, it would be great if it didn’t get us killed.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0600_GP_0011_L: Lando: Now then, let's see what this does.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0600_GP_0014_R: Protocol Droid: Lava pumps operating at 200 percent. Overflow imminent.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0001_S: Shriv: You’re flooding the factory with lava?!?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0002_L: Lando: No, I’m shutting it down.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0003_S: Shriv: With lava. What about the weapons? Iden wants them for the Republic.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0004_L: Lando: I'll apologize later. We can't let the Empire have these weapons!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0006_L: Lando: That didn't work. Maybe it's this button.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0012_L: Lando: When in doubt, blast it.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0014_L: Lando: Blasters tend to solve these kinds of problems...
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0020_L: Lando: If I position that walker just right, I should be able to cross over.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0021_L: Lando: Ugh, I don't have time for this.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0022_R: Protocol Droid: Attention all personnel. Lava dispersion rates increasing. Assemblies at risk. Evacuation is recommended.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0023_R: Protocol Droid: Be advised, lava levels are rising. Assembly Blocks A and B should be evacuated immediately.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0024_R: Protocol Droid: Update: Assembly Block B has melted. All manufacturing has halted.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0700_GP_0025_R: Protocol Droid: Critical support beams, disintegrated. Factory stability, zero percent.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0800_GP_0001_L: Lando: Shriv, did you find us a ride?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0800_GP_0002_S: Shriv: New plan! Meet me in the back, near the assembly line!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0800_GP_0003_S: Shriv: Look! I'm taking another enormous risk!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0800_GP_0005_S: Shriv: Hey! You paying attention over there? Get in here!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0800_GP_0006_S: Shriv: Pick up the pace, Calrissian.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0800_GP_0008_L: Lando: Shriv, I could kiss you.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0810_NIS_0001_: Lando: Move over so I can drive.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0810_NIS_0002_: Lando: This is gonna be fun!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0004_S: Shriv: Um, zero? We seem to have melted them.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0006_S: Shriv: One desperate Duros and one ridiculous man in a cape.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0013_L: Lando: You couldn't find anything roomier?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0014_S: Shriv: You’re welcome to get out and walk.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0015_L: Lando: Were you always this pleasant?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0016_S: Shriv: Only with you. It’s how I show my love.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0019_S: Shriv: No no no! Come back, shuttle, I wanted to steal you!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0023_L: Lando: Call Iden and tell her we're ready for pickup.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0026_I: Iden: Great! How many weapons are picking up?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0027_S: Shriv: Iden? Iden are you still there?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0028_S: Shriv: I lost her. What was that?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0029_L: Lando: That was the sound of my plan working perfectly.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0030_L: Lando: Quick question. Did they build that factory inside a volcano?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0031_S: Shriv: Yes. Yes they did. Walk us to that landing pad. We need to steal their shuttle!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0032_S: Shriv: The volcano’s going to erupt, isn’t it? Actually, don’t tell me. I want it to be a surprise.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0033_L: Lando: I sure hope Iden’s on her way.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0038_S: Shriv: I don’t care if you see them. I just want you to shoot them!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0039_L: Lando: Are you going to be like this whole way?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0040_S: Shriv: It’s a distinct possibility. Your cape is in my way again.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0041_S: Shriv: Unless this walker can fly, I think we're out of options.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0042_I: Iden: I was very specific about your mission parameters!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M3SUL_DS02_S0900_GP_0043_S: Shriv: Head toward that shuttle, get us to higher ground! Uh, what can I do?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0007_L: Lindsey: This is Captain Lindsey! Our ship has crashed and Imperials walkers are cutting through the survivors! We need evac, now.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0011_S: Shriv: Commander, we gotta get to Captain Lindsey.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0012_S: Shriv: Iden, our allies need help. We should go.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0013_S: Shriv: We're supposed to be rescuing our men, remember?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0014_L: Lindsey: Inferno! Those AT-ATs are closing in on our crash-site.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0015_I: Iden: Keep us covered, Captain, we're landing on your position.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0016_L: Lindsey: You'll need something stronger than that, Versio.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0017_L: Lindsey: We need assistance on the ground.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0018_L: Lindsey: You're clear to land on my position, Inferno!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0027_L: Lindsey: Commander, the binocs are close.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0033_L: Lindsey: The walkers are still coming!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0042_S: Shriv: Can we talk about that orbital strike thing for a minute?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0044_S: Shriv: That... I think that was the best thing I have ever seen.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0045_I: Iden: You almost sound like you're enjoying yourself.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0047_S: Shriv: All right. To the X-wings, I guess.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0049_S: Shriv: Don't make me leave without you.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0052_S: Shriv: Oh, lovely. Enemy reinforcements are here!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0053_S: Shriv: Iden! We got more stormtroopers arriving!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0055_S: Shriv: Watch out! More bad guys headed our way!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0058_L: Lindsey: We need that orbital strike!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0061_L: Lindsey: The walkers are too close!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0062_L: Lindsey: That orbital strike will ruin those AT-ATs!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0063_L: Lindsey: We need more orbital strikes, Inferno.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0064_L: Lindsey: We need to hit those walkers with more orbital barrages!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0066_S: Shriv: Del can't take off with you standing there, Commander.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0067_S: Shriv: Iden, let's clear the area.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0068_S: Shriv: Are you just going to stand there, or...? There's a war happening you know.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0069_L: Lindsey: We've lost half our men!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0071_S: Shriv: Not the most inspiring start.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0074_I: Iden: This is Inferno Squad calling Starhawk Command, requesting an orbital strike.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0081_L: Lindsey: Commander, we need you to get those binocs!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0082_L: Lindsey: We gotta take out these walkers!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0087_L: Lindsey: Inferno, we're falling back to the evacuation zone! This way!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0088_I: Iden: Shriv, help get our friends to the **Corvus**!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0090_D: Del: I've got two distress beacons near your location.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0091_I: Iden: Del, we're approaching a distress beacon. Patch me in.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0093_L: Lindsey: Thank you, Commander! We were shot down on our way to Carbon Ridge.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0095_S: Starhawk: This is Starhawk Command. Inferno, you are go for orbital. Paint your target and we'll rain fire.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0096_I: Iden: Then we need an orbital strike. Where are your macrobinoculars?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0098_I: Iden: Shriv and I will get them. Stay here, and lay down cover fire.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0102_I: Iden: Found them. Shriv, patch me into the fleet.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0109_I: Iden: Right there, give me a barrage!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0121_S: Starhawk: Confirmed, that AT-AT is destroyed.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0123_S: Starhawk: The second AT-AT is down. Sorry, Commander, but that’s all we can do. We have to move on.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0124_I: Iden: That's all we need, Starhawk. And thanks. You saved a lot of lives.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0125_I: Iden: Del, let's get Captain Lindsey out of here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0126_D: Del: I'm inbound for pickup, Commander.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0138_S: Shriv: So, what happens if we cross paths with your dad?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0139_I: Iden: We've spent so long trying to track him down, I really don't know what happens if we find him now.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0140_S: Starhawk: This is Starhawk Unity, we can't find a gap in the Empire's formation. There's no breaking through their fleet. Not yet. We need additional support. Does anyone read me? This is Starhawk Unity...
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0142_I: Iden: A fight this size, it’s everyone for themselves. The best thing we can do is focus on what’s down here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0151_D: Del: Iden, are you moving toward a signal?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0152_D: Del: Those beacons are waiting for you, Iden.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0153_D: Del: Iden, there are people down there who need your help.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0154_R: Rebel: New orders from Admiral Ackbar, we need to secure access to an Imperial facility in Carbon Ridge! Can I get any assistance on the ground?!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0157_I: Iden: Hey, we're still alive. Del, where can we be useful?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0159_I: Iden: We should focus. He's not the mission.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0160_I: Iden: This is Commander Iden Versio, Inferno Squad. Help is on the way, Captain.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0161_L: Lindsey: We can’t evacuate until those walkers have been destroyed.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0162_L: Lindsey: When we fell back to this position, the binocs got left behind!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0177_L: Lindsey: Stay strong! Hold the line!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0178_L: Lindsey: We won't last much longer!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0190_I: Iden: Shriv, back to our ships.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0192_I: Iden: One more and that walker is done for.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0450_GP_0193_D: Del: Hello, Captain Lindsey. Welcome to the **Corvus**.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0015_S: Shriv: This is fun and all but...shouldn't we be getting to that Star Destroyer?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0016_S: Shriv: Every TIE we take down here is another one launched. We should go.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0017_S: Shriv: Commander, you ready to advance on that crashed Destroyer?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0023_S: Shriv: OH GREAT. TIE FIGHTER UP TOP!!!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0027_S: Shriv: Okie-doke. Let's get out of here. Fast.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0028_S: Shriv: That would be their rescue team...
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0029_C: Imperial: Our bombers are keeping the Republic at bay for now. Gather any equipment you can. We need to be ready when the evacuation shuttle arrives.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0042_D: Del: Commander, that downed Star Destroyer is deploying bomber reinforcements to an Imperial research facility at Carbon Ridge.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0043_S: Shriv: That facility is a key target for the Republic. Iden, we could cut off those bombers from inside the hangar.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0044_I: Iden: Great idea. Find somewhere to land.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0045_I: Iden: We get inside and search the wreckage for remote detonators.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0057_S: Shriv: They don't know we're here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0058_I: Iden: Good. Stay close, wait until I open fire.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0063_I: Iden: That’s all of them. We’ve got a clear path to the hangar.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0066_I: Iden: Time to shut down the hangar for good.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0068_S: Shriv: We should get back to our ships.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0069_S: Shriv: We gotta keep moving Commander.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0073_S: Shriv: We're landing near the hangar, right?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0074_S: Shriv: I know this was my idea, but...how are we gonna shut down that hangar?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0085_I: Iden: We just need those detonators.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0087_S: Shriv: That's not gonna be enough.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0088_I: Iden: Keep an eye out for more.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0089_I: Iden: Bet they didn't see that coming.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0090_S: Shriv: So, where do we plant these charges?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0091_I: Iden: Straight onto the TIEs. An explosion that size will chain all the way through the ion engine systems.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0093_S: Shriv: I hope we planted enough detonators.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0095_S: Shriv: It's beautiful. Is this what happiness feels like?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0096_I: Iden: They're protecting supplies in here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0097_S: Shriv: A shuttle is probably on the way to pick them up. We should hurry.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0099_S: Shriv: They're coming from that hangar.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0100_I: Iden: First, we need enough detonators. Then that's where we're going.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0101_S: Shriv: Look at all this wreckage.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0102_I: Iden: Somebody laid into the underside of the ship, that's for sure.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0103_S: Shriv: One less Destroyer for the Republic fleet to worry about.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0104_I: Iden: One more problem for us to solve down here.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0115_S: Shriv: And shatter the ship from the inside out.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0120_I: Iden: Get 'em out of our way!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0600_GP_0121_I: Iden: Keep it up, we're almost out of this!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0800_GP_0006_D: Del: Good job, down there. Captain Lindsey and his men are taking Carbon Ridge right now.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0800_GP_0007_I: Iden: Couldn’t have done it without you.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0800_GP_0009_I: Iden: How's it going up there?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0800_GP_0010_D: Del: Hard to tell, but...I think the Empire is losing.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0800_GP_0011_I: Iden: I think you're right. I can feel it. It's almost over. Today, the Empire dies.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS02_S0800_GP_0013_I: Iden: Shriv, regroup with the **Corvus**. Del, find out where else we can help.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0005_I: Iden: Hask. I knew you couldn’t pass up this opportunity.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0015_D: Del: We're taking too much damage!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0016_D: Del: Iden, I need coverage on those TIEs!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0019_S: Shriv: Not yet! We've got another squadron coming our way!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0020_D: Del: Can't take many more hits like that!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0021_D: Del: Iden, please handle those bombers!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0022_D: Del: Commander, I'm almost done for here!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0024_S: Shriv: We've got another TIE squadron inbound but...something's different. They're coming right for you.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0025_I: Iden: They’ll have to get through us first. Let's take them down!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0026_D: Del: Draw those bombers away from the **Corvus**!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0027_D: Del: Keep those bombers off us!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0028_D: Del: We won’t last much longer!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0029_D: Del: Those bombers are tearing us apart!
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0030_D: Del: Iden, I don’t think we’re gonna make it.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0049_I: Iden: Shriv, protect the **Corvus**. I'll take care of this.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0051_H: Hask: Believe me, you and Del are the least of my concerns today. There’s more going on here than you understand.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0053_H: Hask: This is the end Iden, for you and your New Republic.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0054_I: Iden: No. You're on the wrong side of history.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0055_I: Iden: Did you track me down yourself, or did my father send you?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0056_H: Hask: Would one hurt more than the other?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0057_I: Iden: No. I'm just curious who holds the bigger grudge.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0058_H: Hask: The Admiral ordered me to find you. Your attacks on Bespin and Sullust really got under his skin.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0059_I: Iden: I bet you jumped at the opportunity.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0060_H: Hask: How could I refuse the orders of my commanding officer?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0061_I: Iden: I never wanted to be your enemy, Hask.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0062_H: Hask: Then you shouldn’t have turned your back on, on the Empire.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0063_I: Iden: I did what I had to. I'm sorry.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0064_H: Hask: I'm not. You're a traitor. You don't deserve to live. So I will see you dead.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1000_GP_0065_D: Del: The Admiral is sending bombers after the **Corvus**.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1500_GP_0033_I: Iden: I'm okay, Del. I'm going to find a way inside. You and Shriv follow the next distress signal.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1500_GP_0034_D: Del: Iden, no way! We're coming back for you right now.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1500_GP_0035_I: Iden: No you're not. That's an order. Droid, disable comms.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1500_GP_0053_I: Iden: I think that's all of them. Let's find an entrance.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1600_GP_0007_I: Iden: We need to get my father off this ship before it goes down.
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1600_GP_0008_G: Garrick: This is Admiral Garrick Versio. The time for the **Eviscerator**'s emergency evac-
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1800_GP_0033_I: Iden: Del! The **Eviscerator** is going down. Do you copy?
ID_SW02_VO_A2_M4JAK_DS04_S1800_GP_0038_I: Iden: Gotta get to Del. Gotta stay alive.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS02_S0200_GP_0001_G: Gleb: Ah. Hello. Uh... We have been expecting you.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS02_S0200_GP_0002_K: Kylo Ren: Show me to the prisoner.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS02_S0200_GP_0003_G: Gleb: Of course. This way, please.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS02_S0200_GP_0004_G: Gleb: We had to physically subdue the prisoner. I hope that is all right. My men kept the damage to a minimum. Some bruising, a few scrapes, a broken bone or two. Nothing that would get in the way of your questions, of course. We are not savages.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0500_GP_0002_D: Del: Get out of my head!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0500_GP_0003_D: Del: I won't tell you anything.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0500_GP_0004_K: Kylo Ren: You think this ship will protect you. Keep you safe.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0004_K: Kylo Ren: This is where you began.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0005_K: Kylo Ren: You hoped the Empire would make you brave.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0006_K: Kylo Ren: Do you feel brave now?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0007_K: Kylo Ren: Lor San Tekka has the map to Skywalker.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0008_D: Del: I don't know what you're talking about...
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0009_K: Kylo Ren: Where did he take it?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0010_K: Kylo Ren: Your memories are so easily broken.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0700_GP_0011_K: Kylo Ren: You will tell me. Eventually.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0750_GP_0005_D: Del: ...What is it you want, Captain?...
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0750_GP_0006_I: Iden: ...Well, we'll just have to see...
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0750_GP_0010_I: Iden: ...You've seen a lot more combat than I have...
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0800_GP_0007_K: Kylo Ren: She was brave enough for both of you.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0800_GP_0009_K: Kylo Ren: She led you to ruin.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0800_GP_0013_K: Kylo Ren: You were born a coward.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0800_GP_0015_K: Kylo Ren: Iden Versio made you a traitor.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0800_GP_0016_K: Kylo Ren: You think she changed you. That your daughter changed you...
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0850_GP_0002_K: Kylo Ren: You've been here before.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0900_GP_0007_K: Kylo Ren: Faith led you to the Force. The Force brought you to the old man.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0900_GP_0012_K: Kylo Ren: Where did he take the map to Skywalker?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0900_GP_0014_K: Kylo Ren: You were a fool to come back here.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S0900_GP_0015_K: Kylo Ren: It's how they found you.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S1000_GP_0003_K: Kylo Ren: Where your family was broken.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S1000_GP_0004_K: Kylo Ren: I'll break you here again.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S1100_GP_0001_K: Kylo Ren: Tell me where Lor San Tekka took the map.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M1PIL_DS04_S1100_GP_0002_D: Del: ...Bayora. He took it to Bayora.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0047_S: Shriv: Iden. Leema Kai is headed your way in an N-1 starfighter, highly modified. And he's got heavy starfighters backing him up.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0048_Z: Zay: I'll distract Leema Kai, you take out his wingmen!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0052_Z: Zay: I can keep his attention, but not forever!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0053_I: Iden: You've got this, just stay focused.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0054_Z: Zay: Are you done with his friends yet?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0056_Z: Zay: Mom! Finish those guys and help me out!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0057_I: Iden: Just need a little longer!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0061_Z: Zay: Those bombs are tearing the asteroid apart!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0066_S: Shriv: Bomb coming at you! Move!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0067_L: Leema Kai: Got something for you!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0070_S: Shriv: Iden, your ion pulse should disable those bombs.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0071_S: Shriv: Remember to use your ion pulse.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0073_L: Leema Kai: Watch out back there.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0074_L: Leema Kai: Let's see you dodge this.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0075_L: Leema Kai: This one's got your name on it.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0078_L: Leema Kai: I was really hoping to see that.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0079_L: Leema Kai: Why? I wanted to hear that sound.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0080_L: Leema Kai: Did I drop a dud or something?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0081_I: Iden: One down! Now let's see about your friend.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0083_I: Iden: Zay, I'm on my way.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0086_Z: Zay: I'm fine. But look out, Leema Kai's circling back for you.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0088_I: Iden: Okay, I'll take care of him. You just get back to safety on the **Corvus**.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0092_I: Iden: Systems disabled, Dio, do what you can.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0094_I: Iden: Dio! Are you okay back there?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0098_I: Iden: Blast it, I lost my shields!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0101_I: Iden: That bomb knocked out my targeting.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0111_Z: Zay: Hey, dad installed ion pulse systems in our X-wings ages ago, right?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M2ATH_DS02_S0320_GP_0112_I: Iden: Good thinking. That should deactivate the bombs before they explode.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0031_L: Leema Kai: We sure are. This is Leema Kai of the **Opportunity**, calling the **Corvus**. Surrender now, before this gets ugly.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0032_I: Iden: I was about to tell you the same thing.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0033_L: Leema Kai: Heh. Gleb said you were stubborn. But hey, at least I tried. So long, Commander.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0035_I: Iden: Can you bring the **Corvus** up alongside that frigate?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0036_S: Shriv: Not until you take out those ships. I can dodge asteroids or I can dodge lasers. I can't do both.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0038_Z: Zay: I'm picking up starfighters and transports. What should I focus on?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0039_I: Iden: They all have to go. Just follow my lead, and watch out for those asteroids.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0040_Z: Zay: Don't worry, mom. I remember what you taught me.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0045_Z: Zay: We need you back here.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0046_S: Shriv: We need you here, Iden.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0053_S: Shriv: I'm hit! Help me out.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0054_S: Shriv: Keep 'em off me, would you?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0062_I: Iden: Steer clear of those asteroids.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0063_I: Iden: Those asteroids are getting close.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0065_S: Shriv: Iden, take out those ships.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0066_S: Shriv: Iden, take out those ships, will you?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0067_S: Shriv: I thought you were gonna clear me a path.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0068_S: Shriv: Iden, those J-Sec ships are in my way.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0069_S: Shriv: This would be easier if you took out those fighters.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0073_S: Shriv: Gleb's guys still need to get lasered.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0075_I: Iden: We need to take out those starfighters.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0078_I: Iden: Zay, help me take down those V-wings.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0080_I: Iden: We should focus on those transports.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0082_I: Iden: Those transports are gonna be a problem.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0084_I: Iden: Time to deal with those transports.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0099_Z: Zay: That’s what they get for flying those old ships.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0100_I: Iden: Old doesn't mean bad. If they can shoot, they're dangerous.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0101_L: Leema Kai: You know, taking out my ships won't stop our operation.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0103_L: Leema Kai: That's Gleb's name for it. I just call it what it is – trafficking.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0104_I: Iden: You're not kidnapping anyone else today, Leema Kai.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0105_L: Leema Kai: Is that what you think? I have quotas to meet. If I don't fill them here, I'll do it somewhere else.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0106_I: Iden: I don't think so. You're not going anywhere.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0107_I: Iden: Shriv, can you get the **Corvus** in range of the frigate?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0108_S: Shriv: Are those transports attacking us?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0109_L: Leema Kai: Weaponized carriers are the only way to go anymore.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0110_I: Iden: We'll watch their fire. Zay, on me, let's take down those transports.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0111_Z: Zay: Their convoy is protecting the frigate. I can't get to the Opportunity.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0112_I: Iden: Fire on the transports. Cut through the convoy and we can close in on the frigate.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0117_I: Iden: The Athullan said J-Sec was kidnapping families. They must be here for more.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0300_GP_0118_S: Shriv: Scanners say the transports are almost empty. Gleb's forces must kidnap Athullans and ship them off on the transports.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0001_I: Iden: We need to slow down the J-Sec frigate. Shriv, draw their fire and we'll take out the engines.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0004_S: Shriv: Iden, I'm ready when you are.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0006_S: Shriv: Iden, it's time to lay into the Opportunity!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0007_I: Iden: Let's move in on the frigate!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0009_I: Iden: We need to catch up with the **Corvus**.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0011_I: Iden: Let's get to that frigate.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0014_S: Shriv: Fill those engines with lasers and torpedoes, Iden.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0015_S: Shriv: I need you to get firepower on the frigate's engines.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0016_I: Iden: We need to destroy the **Opportunity**'s engines.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0017_Z: Zay: You know what you’re doing. I’m just following you.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0018_I: Iden: Those engines are still active.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0021_I: Iden: Then let's keep at it.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0024_S: Shriv: You did it! The engines are fried.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0025_I: Iden: Leema Kai, this is the last chance I'll give you to surrender.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0026_L: Leema Kai: Gleb doesn't pay me to surrender. She pays me to get the job done, and that's what I'm gonna do.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0030_L: Leema Kai: Leave my ship alone!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0031_L: Leema Kai: Ah, for hutt's sake! Stop that!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0033_L: Leema Kai: I need those. Quit it.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0310_GP_0035_L: Leema Kai: Gleb was right, you are trouble.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0018_S: Shriv: He can't dodge you forever, Iden.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0019_S: Shriv: Shut that guy up. Forever.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0020_L: Leema Kai: I came all this way, lady, let's do this.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0021_L: Leema Kai: What's going on, are we fighting or not?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0023_L: Leema Kai: Ow! Knock it off!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0024_L: Leema Kai: Blast it! Come on!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0025_L: Leema Kai: You're not gonna win this!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0027_L: Leema Kai: What do you care about Athulla, anyway?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0028_I: Iden: You're kidnapping people and selling them off.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0030_I: Iden: That doesn't make it better!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0031_L: Leema Kai: Have you even seen Athulla? The planet is a nightmare! I don't know where Gleb sends these kids, but I guarantee she's doing them a favor.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0032_L: Leema Kai: You know, I only took this job because it was supposed to be easy.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0033_L: Leema Kai: Steady pay, hot food, a minimum number of people trying to stab me in the back.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0034_L: Leema Kai: In this line of work, that's practically retirement. You are ruining my retirement!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M3ATH_DS02_S0330_GP_0037_S: Shriv: I know it's a strong word and all, but...I really hated that guy.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0200_GP_0016_S: Shriv: Iden, why’d you ask Zay to stay on the **Corvus**? She did great over Athulla. We could really use her down here.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0200_GP_0017_I: Iden: Gleb is part of my life I’d like to forget. It’s one thing for Zay to know about my past. It’s another for her to stare it in the face.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0200_GP_0019_S: Shriv: At least it's snowing. That's nice.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0200_GP_0021_I: Iden: That isn’t snow. It’s atmospheric ash, left over from Operation: Cinder. The remains of a city that’s been dead for decades.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0200_GP_0022_S: Shriv: You know what, I’m just going to stop talking.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0200_GP_0023_I: Iden: Last I heard, people were still living here. I thought Gleb gave up on Vardos when the Empire did. I was wrong.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_SE_0009_S: Shriv: The First Order. It has to be. What have they done?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_SE_0011_I: Iden: Come on. We find Gleb, we find out what happened to Del. Then you can get back to the Resistance and figure out what’s going on.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_SE_0012_S: Shriv: Iden, we should hurry inside.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0300_SE_0014_S: Shriv: You ready? Let's go to the Archive.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0001_S: Shriv: If the Republic is gone, the First Order must have a...some kind of superweapon. Could they really destroy the entire Hosnian System?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0002_I: Iden: We can grieve later. Right now we need to find Zay.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0016_S: Shriv: I'll walk, you go ahead.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0017_S: Shriv: Take that walker. I'll find you.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0018_S: Shriv: AT-RT is yours, I'll follow.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0046_S: Shriv: Those walkers are dangerous. Fast, too. Could be useful.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0047_S: Shriv: I don't want to make myself a target. I'll stick with walking.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0070_S: Shriv: J-Sec is fighting the First Order?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0071_I: Iden: They’re defending Vardos, and protecting themselves. It doesn’t mean J-Sec is on our side.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0072_S: Shriv: Look. They're too busy tearing each other apart to notice us.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0073_I: Iden: Then we use that to our advantage. Let's go.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0076_I: Iden: Watch out! J-Sec has an AT-ST.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0077_S: Shriv: You wanna run, or find heavy weapons to take it down?
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0079_S: Shriv: One of 'em has a flamethrower.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0450_GP_0080_I: Iden: They're in our way. Take 'em down.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0014_S: Shriv: That’s an escape pod from the **Corvus**! If Zay launched them before the crash, maybe she got out!
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0015_I: Iden: Dio, find a communication relay. We'll scan the city for rescue beacons.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0018_S: Shriv: The relay is pretty close.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0020_S: Shriv: Looks like another fight up ahead.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0021_I: Iden: Push through to the relay.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0022_I: Iden: Dio, scan for rescue beacons across the city.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0024_S: Shriv: Two is better than zero.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0025_I: Iden: You're right. Let's find Zay.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0027_S: Shriv: Let's get to that rescue beacon.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0500_GP_0030_S: Shriv: Iden, we gotta find Zay.
ID_SW02_VO_A3_M4VAR_DS02_S0600_GP_0008_I: Iden: Find heavy weapons and take it down! We need to search that pod!
